title: 12 Angry Men
synopsis: A jury room, a stalled fan, a knife on a table, and one juror asking whether reasonable doubt has been considered.

nodes.text: Eleven hands up for guilty, fast, in a hot room.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
There is no taking “Hold it down” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Foreman asks for a reason and the room stares.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Speak.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cautious.

nodes.text: Juror Eight pulls an identical knife from his pocket.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Bold.
“Pocket it again” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Quiet.

nodes.text: You walk down the courthouse steps with a stranger whose first name you finally learn. You do not exchange numbers. You do not need to.
The boy walks. He is innocent or guilty and the room never found out. You learn to live with that distinction, which is the entire point.
Juror Three calls his son that night from a payphone, and the line is busy. He calls again at six in the morning. He calls every day until it is not.
